title: The NROL-16 patch and Ron Pandolfi
summary: Jesse Michels tells of The NROL-16 patch and Ron Pandolfi, about 2005 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: continued into the 21st century. In a presentation, former CIA officer John Ramirez described one particular case, the 2005 launch of NROL 16.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels relays a case described by John Ramirez, a former officer of the CIA, the US spy agency, in a presentation. It concerns NROL-16, a 2005 launch for the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, and its mission patch, the cloth emblem made for the launch, which Ramirez links to a man named Ron Pandolfi. Michels tells it as an example of hidden symbolism tied to the UFO subject carrying on into the 21st century.
